## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-automation-actions-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to the HubSpot developer portal

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your [HubSpot developer account](https://app.hubspot.com/). -->

## Step 3: Create a HubSpot app

2. Select **Create app** and provide a name and optional description.
3. <!-- manual: Select Create app and provide a name and optional description. -->
